metadata.content: Synthetic, general-knowledge English sentences. No customer data, no secrets.

preprocessing.claim_splitter: longtracer.guard.claim_splitter.split_into_claims (whitespace-normalised; responses <= 10 chars and sentences <= 15 chars dropped)

leakage_check.method: Across calibration x held-out pairs: exact match after lower-casing and whitespace normalisation, plus token Jaccard >= 0.8 on the response and on the concatenated source text.
